journey: Guest journey through the normal owned static application in Firefox. Each entry was opened after its actual encounter. The browser decoded the registered portrait and checked its visible caption and alternative text.

portrait.caption: The Apprentice pauses over a blank notebook, pencil in hand and brass goggles pushed up into dark curls.
Photon tilts a dark, smiling face between two glowing feelers. Thin wings rise over a lantern-shaped abdomen bound with teal rings.
The Titan cradles a tiny enamel mug in one stone hand. A lamp sits on the copper brim of the guardian’s helmet.
Iron Golem gestures beside the three brass-handled drawers in its chest. A teal faceplate frames two round eyes and a small smile.
Copperhead rests in a coil of polished copper and dark insulating bands, with two slender brass probes beside its cheek.
The Crosstalk Twins look at each other. The round copper twin speaks while the square teal twin smiles, their striped cable bodies twisted together.
Echo Bat cocks its head between two tall dish-shaped ears. Copper-edged wings frame the round brass pendant on its chest.
Ancient Tortoise smiles behind round spectacles beneath a postmaster’s cap. Its shell carries a letter pouch and a raised mail flag.
The Single-Mode Unicorn has one pale horn and a smooth teal mane. A leather strap crosses its shoulder to a small ledger case.
The Multimode Hydra’s three striped necks rise from one body. The middle head wears spectacles above a single brass gauge.
SFP Hermit Crab lifts an orange claw beneath a ribbed silver shell. A copper bail curves above its eyes and meets a teal side latch.
Rainbow Serpent curls its striped neck beneath a fan of violet, blue and mint cheek scales. Two small brass keys hang beside its face.
Thunderbird peers through a survey monocle between two fans of long, blue-green feathers tipped with gold.
Blue Dragon holds out a tiny ceremonial receipt. Two banded ivory horns rise between the blue sails of its wings.
Microwave Phoenix spreads fans of russet and gold feathers around the small brass alignment dial on its chest.
Celestial Eagle looks into the distance beneath a thin gold orbital ring, a teal chart pouch hanging against its breast.
Noise Demon shrugs beneath two golden horns. Its worried brows and red nose stand out against a jagged mane of dark blue, plum and teal.
QSFP Chimera’s ram, lion and serpent heads rise from one purple body. A blank tag hangs from the metal module on its back.
Electric Eel bends its dark teal body into a hook. Copper fins frame its blunt snout, and a square ledger hangs below its chin.
DSL Mole raises a pink, ivory-clawed paw. Pale whiskers fan over a braided copper-and-teal collar.
DOCSIS Badger carries a teal coaxial spool on a copper shoulder harness. Two dark stripes run down its long white face.
Metronome Golem raises a brass hand. A pendulum hangs in its tapered teal chest, with a winding key beside its smiling square head.
Chameleon looks two ways at once. Raised square scales checker its green flank, and its dark tail coils into a tight spiral.
Red Scorpion peers out between broad pincers. Its segmented red tail curls up to a gold-rimmed ruby lens.
The Backhoe of Doom fixes a sideways glare on its own yellow cab. Its eyes sit on the dirt-streaked bucket at the end of the jointed boom.
